decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanRear elevation proposed window + doorFront elevation proposed window + doorFloor plansProposed floor plansHeritage StatementTechnical Guide: Heritage Flush SashHeritage Flush SashSite photographsReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.
All new external work shall be carried out in materials as specified in the approved application.Reason: To ensure a design which complies with Development Plan Policies.

The external vent grilles hereby approved shall be finished as follows: - the first-floor vent grille shall be finished in a brown colour to match the host building's brickwork; and - the ground floor vent grille shall be finished in a colour to match the rendered façade. The grilles shall be retained in these colours thereafter.Reason: To ensure that the development preserves the character and appearance of the Bush Hill Park Conservation Area.
description: Replacement windows/doors to property and installation of extractor fans to bathroom and toilet.
